title: Contraste y tópicos múltiples en mandarín

claimAssessments.claim: Chou (2025) reports that, for some native speakers, multiple gapped DP topicalization can be acceptable under a contrastive interpretation in a contextual question–answer setting. The article treats this as a limited judgment, not a general discourse chain, and explicitly leaves the broader interaction for future work.
